name: Intent Hero (Search-Intent Intro)
when_to_pick: Open an article with an above-the-fold hero matched to what the searcher actually came for, instead of a generic featured image. Choose the 'variant' from the post's search intent: 'informational' (answer-first) when the user wants one discrete fact NOW — current price, today's win rate, latency stat: it shows the question, a huge numeric answer with delta, a 4-cell context grid, an inline sparkline from a numbers array, and a source line. 'commercial' (top-pick + why) for 'best X' / 'X vs Y' / 'top N' comparison queries: a pain line, a crowned editor's-pick card with name, 1-5 reasons and an optional short QUALITATIVE verdict badge (what it's best FOR — never a fabricated numeric rating), up to 4 runner-up rows, and a meta/CTA footer. 'transactional' (CTA-first) for signup / free-trial / upgrade pages where the user has decided to act: eyebrow, headline (em-emphasis allowed), subline, a presentational email field + button (NO real submit), a reassurance line, and up to 4 trust items. 'navigational' (destination card) when the user searched for a known place ('SignalBots admin panel'): breadcrumb, title, description, a primary CTA, and a row of related links. Use exactly once per article, at the very top. For mid-article calls-to-action use a callout; for plain headline stats use kpi_sparkline_card.

variant.description: Which hero treatment to render, chosen from the article's search intent. Each variant uses its own field set below (all other fields are ignored).

live_label.description: Small uppercase pulse-dot label, e.g. 'Live data · auto-updated'. Omit to hide the live indicator.

question.description: The searcher's question restated, e.g. 'Bitcoin price right now'.

answer.description: The big numeric answer as a display string, e.g. '$67,432'.

answer_unit.description: Optional small unit suffix after the answer, e.g. 'USD'.

delta.description: Optional signed change shown as a pill, e.g. '+2.34% today'.

delta_dir.description: Direction of the delta pill. up=green/buy with up-triangle, down=red/sell with down-triangle.

context.description: Optional supporting context cells (e.g. 24h high/low, volume, updated time).

value.description: Context value, e.g. '$68,210' or 'EA / API access on your account'.

sparkline.description: Recent values, oldest first. Drawn as an auto-scaled inline SVG sparkline (line + soft fill + end dot). 8-24 points reads best.

source.description: Optional source / freshness line shown bottom-right, e.g. 'Source: CoinGecko · refreshes every 30s'.

pain.description: Optional one-line pain point that validates the search, shown above the pick card.

logo.description: Optional 1-3 char monogram for the pick's logo tile, e.g. 'SB'.

name.description: Name of the recommended pick, e.g. 'SignalBots Pro'.

name_suffix.description: Optional muted suffix after the name, e.g. '— our pick for 2026'.

score.description: Optional short QUALITATIVE verdict badge — what this pick is best FOR, e.g. 'Best for scalping', 'Top US pick', 'API-first'. NEVER a fabricated numeric rating (no '9.4', no '/10' review score): we do not invent ratings (no-stats policy). Omit it unless a genuine one-phrase verdict adds clarity.

score_label.description: Optional short caption under the verdict badge, e.g. 'Our take' or 'Best for'. Not a rating label — never 'Editor score' or anything implying a numeric grade.

runners.description: Optional runner-up rows shown below the pick.

name.description: Runner-up NAME only — a real broker/product/platform name, e.g. 'OANDA' or 'FP Markets'. This is a name, NOT a description: never a phrase like 'Market-maker + slick app (great for beginners)'. Put any 'good for X' nuance in the optional 'note' field.

note.description: Optional short qualitative tag for this runner, e.g. 'Best for API' or 'US-legal'. A complete standalone phrase — never a fabricated numeric score, never a cut-off fragment.

meta.description: Optional footer meta line, e.g. how/when it was tested.

cta_label.description: Optional footer CTA text, e.g. 'See full comparison'. An arrow is appended automatically. Presentational only — no link.

transactional.description: Fields for variant 'transactional' (CTA-first hero). The email field + button are presentational only; there is no real submit.

eyebrow.description: Optional pill eyebrow above the headline, e.g. 'Free 14-day trial'.

headline.description:
Headline as trusted inline HTML — wrap an emphasized phrase in … to accent-color it. Rendered with |safe; only , ,
expected.

email_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the presentational email field.

button_label.description: Label on the presentational button (an arrow is appended automatically).

reassure.description: Optional reassurance line under the form, e.g. refund / cancel terms.

trust.description: Optional trust items shown in a row below the form.

icon.description: Optional short glyph/emoji for the trust tile, e.g. '★'.

breadcrumb.description: Optional breadcrumb segments, root first, e.g. ['signalbots.ai', 'admin-os', 'cms'].

desc.description: Optional one- or two-line description of the destination.

label.description: Primary CTA text, e.g. 'Open console' (arrow appended automatically).

href.description: Optional href for the primary CTA. Defaults to '#'.

related.description: Optional row of related destination links.
